Stewvul is a gnome. He is Narain Soothfancy's former best friend forever. He stole Narain's googles and left for Outland. He later returned to Azeroth and hid himself in a crate at Greymane Wall in Silverpine Forest. An adventurer sent by Narain to retrieve the googles found him, but the gnome did not have the googles on him as he had lost them in Molten Core.

The Stitchmasters are a reputation faction in Maldraxxus, only available to those who join the Necrolord Covenant. They represent elements from the House of Constructs who remained loyal to the Primus' vision of Maldraxxus and have joined with the Necrolord Covenant as a result.
Stoic Mammoths are mammoths located in the Valley of Ancient Winters in the Storm Peaks.
Stockstiller Roux is a Maldraxxi necromancer located in the Hall of Ichor in Maldraxxus.
Stillglade is an area of the dream tree of Tirna Glayn. It is where Marasmius has a station of his root network.

The Stitchyard is the large complex, composing the entire southwestern part of theHouse of Constructs where their constructs are made, overseen previously by Surgeon Stitchflesh. It was later home to four giant juggernaut constructs, until they were defeated by the Maw Walker using the Blade of the Primus. Rathan apprenticed under Stitchflesh for a long time.
Stitchyard Surgeons are Maldraxxi necromancers located in Maldraxxus.

Loot a Ripe Purian and speak with the steward to get Steward's Golden Key. Use it to open Steward's Golden Chest next to Elios.
Steward's Golden Chest is a chest found in Hero's Rest in Bastion. It is unlocked with a Steward's Golden Key.

Steward Saphos is a blue drakonid located in Camp Antonidas in the Azure Span. When the proto-dragons attack the camp, Saphos moves to Mage's Rest.
Steward Portos is a blue drakonid located in Camp Antonidas in the Azure Span. When the proto-dragons attack the camp, Portos moves to Mage's Rest.

Stones are simple mineral items usually gathered from mineral veins or deposits and often usable as an ingredient for professions (usually blacksmithing, engineering, or jewelcrafting). Stones are also a drop from earth elementals, fire elementals, and infernals, corresponding in quality to the mob's level.
The Stone Scarab is a beetle-shaped figurine made of smooth dense stone. It can be found in the Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj.
Stone Guard is a Legacy achievement awarded for reaching the rank of Stone Guard in the pre-2.0 Honor system.
Stomper Kreeg is an ogre found in Dire Maul North. The always-drunk Gordok brewmaster. When you finish a Tribute Run, you'll be able to buy drinks off him, and he'll offer a quest.
Stonearm is a rare centaur found roaming the Kolkar settlements around the Forgotten Pools , . He is on a 1.5-2.5 hour respawn timer.
Stone Maw Basilisks are basilisks found in Northern Stranglethorn. Unlike most basilisks they are not immune to fear.

__NOTOC__ Stone Guardians are golems found in Un'Goro Crater. They once patrolled the river running across the center of the crater. During the Cataclysm, the Stone Guardians invaded Marshal's Refuge and established themselves there, killing Dadanga in the process.
Stoma the Ancient is a spirit of an Ancient of Lore located in the Irontree Woods in Felwood.
The Stomping Boots are a quest reward from Elixir of Pain (quest).

Stone Tokens is a quest to kill Dalaran wizards and gather the stone tokens that they use to control their elemental slaves. It is most efficient to do this quest at the same time as Prison Break In or Dalaran Patrols, as they take place in the same area.
The Stonebough Jerkin is an epic chest piece best suited for restoration and balance druids.
__NOTOC__ Stone Reaper is a world drop from The Burning Crusade mobs.

Stone Guard Ambelan is a tauren found in Spinebreaker Post in the Hellfire Peninsula.
Stoley's Bottle is filled with Steamwheedle bilge rum. It is provided as an objective for Deliver to MacKinley.

The Stone Vault is located inside Uldaman, off the tunnel system beyond the Map Chamber. It is infested with troggs, including the giant Grimlok. The tunnels behind lead to Echomok Cavern, Dig Three, Temple Hall, or back to the Map Chamber, depending on which route is picked. The tunnel beyond leads to the Hall of the Crafters.

The Stolen Cargo is spread out on the second floor of the largest building in the Lost Rigger Cove of Tanaris.

Creative group behind Ballad Of The Noob and Snacky's Journal series of machinima. Founded by Jun Falkenstein.
The Stone of Binding is a crystal located in Blasted Lands. While intact it allows the creature that is bound to it to live forever.
Stolen Supply Sacks can be found scattered throughout Razorwind Canyon in Durotar.

Obtain 6 of these to complete the quest Let Nothing Go To Waste which begins with Elder Ko'nani in Moa'ki Harbor of the Dragonblight.

The Stone of Remembrance is a monument located at Heroes' Vigil, in the center of Stone Cairn Lake in Elwynn Forest. The Stone was once in the hands of the Defias Brotherhood, but is currently surrounded by Rogue Wizards.

Stone Keeper's Shards were a currency added in and removed in Patch 4.0.1, which converted all remaining shards into Honor Points. Prior to their removal, they were gained through completing weekly quests involving Lake Wintergrasp or by defeating dungeon bosses when your faction controls Wintergrasp. You could find your Stone Keeper's Shards tracked on the Currency tab. They were used to buy a plethora of different items from or in Wintergrasp Keep. These NPCs are only accessible when your faction controls the keep. These items are now purchased with Honor Points.
__NOTOC__ Stone-Worn Footwraps drop from Krik'thir the Gatewatcher in Azjol-Nerub on heroic mode.

.]] The Stone Crow Tavern is a tavern located in the King's Square in Stratholme. It was run by Emery Neill while Edward Orrick was its cook. During the Culling of Stratholme, Emery closed it up due to the health concerns about the food cooked by Edward.
Stone Guard Ragetotem is an tauren quest giver stationed at Venture Bay in the Grizzly Hills.
Stonard Cartographers were orcs near Stonard that mapped the contested Swamp of Sorrows.
Stonard Wayfinders are orcs that guide Stonard Cartographers through Swamp of Sorrows.
Stonard Orcs are orcs that live in Stonard in Swamp of Sorrows.
Stonard Grunts are orcs that guard Stonard in Swamp of Sorrows.

Stonard Scouts are orcs that patrol the roads west and south of Stonard in Swamp of Sorrows. Although Alliance players do not usually quest in Swamp of Sorrows, even high level players need to watch out for these scouts, especially on normal servers, because they flag players if they attack.
Stonard Hunters are orcs found at Misty Reed Post in Swamp of Sorrows.
Stonard Shaman are orcs found at Misty Reed Post in Swamp of Sorrows.
Stone Gnoll Hammer drops from Riverpaw Outrunners and Riverpaw Runts in Elwynn Forest.
The frostsaber Shy-Rotam is summoned to the Stone of Shy-Rotam by using Sacred Frostsaber Meat. Storm Shadowhoof wants her killed.
The Stonebloom is fungus found near Gar'gol's Hovel in Mount Hyjal.
Stone Trogg Ambushers are stone troggs invading the Stonehearth in Deepholm. They are fighting the Stonehearth Defenders and are required to be slain in We're Surrounded.

:"Our war has been waged for longer than your kind counts time." :—Earthbreaker Dolomite Stone troggs (or rock troggs) are the original form of troggs before the Curse of Flesh turned many of them into fleshy, mortal creatures. They were created by the Titanic Keepers through the Forge of Wills, but proved to be a failed prototype for the titan-forged. These stone troggs, like the earthen, found their way into Deepholm through Uldum more than fifteen thousand years ago. They've been warring against the earthen ever since, for thousands of years. They often are found working with fungus.
Stone Trogg Diggers are stone troggs located in Stonehearth in Deepholm. They are occupied with mining.
Stone Trogg Berserkers are stone troggs located in Stonehearth in Deepholm. Gravel Longslab wants them killed.
Stone drakes are dragonkin native to Deepholm. They look as if they are made of stone.
Stone Stompers is a quest reward from In Defense of the King's Lands.
Stolen Grain Sack contains Stolen Grain for the quest Animal Services. They can be found at Thorn Hill in the Northern Barrens.
Stolen Grain is found in Stolen Grain Sacks at Thorn Hill in the Northern Barrens.

The Stone Lords are a group of colossi-like earth elementals that rule Deepholm under Therazane. After reaching with Therazane, most of them can be seen at Therazane's Throne. They have a meeting during At the Stonemother's Call. Kor the Immovable does not attend, and Ruberick stands near one of the entrances, having no speaking part.
Stoneblade's is a weapon shop found in the Forlorn Cavern of Ironforge. It's the westernmost building of the Cavern, just next to the Traveling Fisherman. It's presumably owned by Hjoldir Stoneblade.

Stone Guard Nargol is an orc and the quartermaster for the Orgrimmar faction located on the Orgrimmar Skyway in Orgrimmar. Prior to the War of the Thorns, as part of High Overlord Saurfang's efforts to deceive the Alliance, Nargol received a parchment with supply requisitions from Saurfang. Nargol was distressed at the orders, stating that it would take a miracle to gather it all in two months, but the troll courier who delivered the parchment bluntly told him that he had only one month. When Nargol asked what Saurfang was planning, the courier merely shrugged.
Stonard Supplies are lootable objects found in Stonard in the Swamp of Sorrows during Cutting Supply.

Stone Sentinel's Overlook is an area within Blackwing Descent where the Omnotron Defense System can be found. It is located to the right as one enters the instance, with Magmaw's area off to the left.
Stone Guard Towhide is a tauren quest giver at the Great Arena in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
The Stone Slab is found in the Tomb of the Watchers in the Badlands.
Stone Guard Kurjack was an orc quest giver once located just inside Ragefire Chasm.

The Stolen Explorers League Documents are various documents stolen from the Explorers' League offices in Thelsamar by the Dark Iron Dwarf Gorick Guzzledraught. Adventurers and Morick Darkbrew are out to retrieve them. The Explorers' League offers a bounty on each one returned. They start the following quests (one each): * Explorers' League Document (1 of 6) - in a cave just south of Thelsamar * Explorers' League Document (2 of 6) - under the dock north of Thelsamar * Explorers' League Document (3 of 6) - SE of Huldar and Miran, near Shanda the Spinner's cave. * Explorers' League Document (4 of 6) - in Ironband's Excavation Site * Explorers' League Document (5 of 6) - a little south of Twilig
The Stolen Present is a quest reward from You're a Mean One... for max-level players. For players below max-level, the Stolen Gift will be the quest reward instead.

Stone Cold Trixxy is a grand master Pet Tamer located in Ice Thistle Hills in Winterspring. She is surrounded by her three battle pets: Blizzy, Tinygos, and Frostmaw. Defeating her is required to complete the Taming Kalimdor achievement.
